question: For each migration status and instance VM state (considering only active migrations where the instance has at least 8 vCPUs), return the number of migrations and the earliest migration creation time, along with the overall average migration count across all (migration status, VM state) groups and a utilization category of 'HIGH_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY'. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT m.status AS migration_status,
         i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state,
         m.id AS migration_id,
         m.created_at AS migration_created_at
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE m.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')
    AND i.vcpus >= 8
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT migration_status,
         instance_vm_state,
         COUNT(migration_id) AS migration_count,
         MIN(migration_created_at) AS earliest_migration_creation_time
  FROM base
  GROUP BY migration_status, instance_vm_state
),
avg_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS overall_avg_migration_count
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT g.migration_status,
       g.instance_vm_state,
       g.migration_count,
       g.earliest_migration_creation_time,
       a.overall_avg_migration_count,
       CASE
         WHEN g.migration_count >= a.overall_avg_migration_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY'
         WHEN g.migration_count <= a.overall_avg_migration_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY'
         ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY'
       END AS utilization_category
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN avg_cte a

WITH vm_state_migration_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_total) AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean_memory_total, b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total > b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION' WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total < b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION' END AS migration_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), confirmed_ether60_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, i.DISPLAY_NAME m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') AND m2.id <> inner_cte.migration_id) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS project_has_other_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN cem.dest_compute, cem.instance_display_name, cem.instance_vm_state, cem.instance_memory_mb, cem.window_column, cem.project_id, cem.project_has_other_active_migrations, vms.geometric_mean_memory_total WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MigrationStats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), Combined AS (SELECT fi.instance_id, fi.instance_uuid, fi.user_id, fi.project_id, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.power_state, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.availability_zone, fi.info_cache_id, fi.network_info, fi.window_column, ms.migration_status, ms.migration_count, ms.min_instance_memory_mb FROM ForgeInstances AS fi LEFT JOIN MigrationStats AS ms ON fi.vm_state = ms.instance_vm_state) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY instance_id, migration_status), AverageMemory AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_id, ic.instance_uuid, ic.user_id, ic.project_id, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.availability_zone, ic.info_cache_id, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_count, ic.min_instance_memory_mb, (ic.memory_mb - am.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory AS am ORDER BY ic.instance_id, ic.migration_status

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), avg_meta AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(metadata_value AS FLOAT)) AS avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (CAST(ic.metadata_value AS FLOAT) - am.avg_metadata_value) AS deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_meta AS am), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i2.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i3 ON m2.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.metadata_value, q1.NETWORK_INFO, q1.window_column, q1.deviation_from_avg_metadata_value, q2.metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev, q2.has_active_migrations FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND NOT i.key_name IS NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.power_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.instance_extra_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, tcm.completed_migrations, ROUND(tcm.completed_migrations / NULLIF(id.vcpus, 0), 2) AS completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM InstanceDetails AS id JOIN TopCompletedMigrations AS tcm ON tcm.display_name = id.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, tcm.completed_migrations DESC), OverallAvg AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.completed_migrations * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, inner_cte.completed_migrations, inner_cte.completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.completed_migrations * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) > (SELECT avg_completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM OverallAvg) ORDER BY inner_cte.completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, inner_cte.completed_migrations DESC

WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic2.DELETED = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.hostname, q1.vm_state, q1.power_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.availability_zone, q1.info_cache_id, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_project, q2.min_instance_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_min_instance_memory_mb, q2.total_migration_memory_processed, q2.has_network_info_cache FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.vm_state = q1.vm_state WHERE q1.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MigrationStats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), Combined AS (SELECT fi.instance_id, fi.instance_uuid, fi.user_id, fi.project_id, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.power_state, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.availability_zone, fi.info_cache_id, fi.network_info, fi.window_column, ms.migration_status, ms.migration_count, ms.min_instance_memory_mb FROM ForgeInstances AS fi LEFT JOIN MigrationStats AS ms ON fi.vm_state = ms.instance_vm_state) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY instance_id, migration_status), AverageMemory AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_id, ic.instance_uuid, ic.user_id, ic.project_id, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.availability_zone, ic.info_cache_id, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_count, ic.min_instance_memory_mb, (ic.memory_mb - am.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory AS am ORDER BY ic.instance_id, ic.migration_status

WITH base AS (
  SELECT m.status AS migration_status,
         i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state,
         m.id AS migration_id,
         m.created_at AS migration_created_at
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE m.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')
    AND i.vcpus >= 8
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT migration_status,
         instance_vm_state,
         COUNT(migration_id) AS migration_count,
         MIN(migration_created_at) AS earliest_migration_creation_time
  FROM base
  GROUP BY migration_status, instance_vm_state
),
avg_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS overall_avg_migration_count
  FROM grouped
)
